mapper.select: SELECT uf.favorite_id, uf.product_id, p.name as product_name, p.main_image, p.price, p.original_price, p.status, uf.created_at FROM user_favorite uf LEFT JOIN product p ON uf.product_id = p.product_id WHERE uf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uf.created_at DESC
